note: Small family-owned park in open country a mile south of US 34 near Murray. The pull-through pads sit in a gravel fan beside the office, about 60-150 m from a small fishing lake (electric motors only) with a beach, water slide, docks and paddle-boat rentals; also a golf driving range, a tent area, a waterfront rental camper and a cabin. Buddy sites: 1-2, 3-7, 4-5. Come in from US 34 on paved R15: an RV Life camper (9/2026) warns that a route from the south via Grand River runs about 5 miles on dirt. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $40 (page undated; campers paid $40-41 in 2026), reservable. Added 50 A, 12 sites, the full-hookup split, holiday 3-night minimum, check-in, operator booking; confirmed water/sewer, pull-throughs, showers, laundry. Lakeview confirmed on imagery (fan 60-150 m from the lake past the office road and beach area). Phone stored wrong (4449 vs posted 4448). Pin on the office house, ~135 m from the site fan; within tolerance. Season not stated.
flags: PHONE: stored 641-414-4449 is not on any operator page. The contact block and Google Maps give 641-414-4448; the site header shows 641-414-9732. Suggest 641-414-4448 (apply.py does not write phone).

PRIVATE GATE FACTS: posted $40/night (rate page undated, footer (c) 2023; RV Life campers paid $41 9/2026, $41 and $40 5/2026), under $50; no gateway within 40 km (gateways.py: nearest Kansas City 219 km); Good Sam directory isGsPark false. Presence: working website with phone, Google Maps open 4.8 stars / 51 reviews, 641-414-4448. RV Life 4 stars (5 reviews, all 2026). Not borderline.

LONG-STAY: monthly ($650 + utilities) and seasonal ($3,000 + utilities) rates are offered, and 3 of 12 sites (1, 2, 4) are metered for extended stays, but nightly is the lead price and 4 of 5 2026 RV Life reviews are ordinary nightly stays (one monthly). Passes test 4 (9 of 12 not metered); not mostly seasonal.

WATERFRONT (lakeview kept): NAIP shows the RV fan at ~41.0121,-93.9542 with the lake's south-west shore about 60 m from the nearest pads and ~150 m from the farthest, across the campground's own road, the office/beach/water-slide area and grass. Lake ~2.5-3 ha (6-7 acres, imagery estimate; the operator calls it a 'small lake'), above the ~5-acre pond line. No pad on the water; the waterfront camper rental and cabin sit at the shore, not RV sites.
